gloss: to economize; to save; to cut back on (expenses, resources)

definitions.gloss: to economize; to save; to cut back on (expenses, resources)
definitions.explanation: to economize; to save; to cut back on (expenses, resources)

examples.japanese: {電気代|でんきだい}を{節約|せつやく}する。
{時間|じかん}を{節約|せつやく}するために{電車|でんしゃ}で{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went by train to save time.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{少|すこ}しずつ{節約|せつやく}して、{旅行|りょこう}の{費用|ひよう}を{貯|た}めている。
examples.english: I'm saving a little each month to set aside money for a trip.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}を{節約|せつやく}するために、シャワーの{時間|じかん}を{短|みじか}くしている。
examples.english: I keep my showers short to conserve water.

notes:
Refers to the conscious effort to reduce consumption or spending in order to avoid waste. Can be applied to money, time, energy, water, and other resources. Implies prudent, deliberate reduction rather than deprivation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食費|しょくひ}を{節約|せつやく}する: economize on food expenses
- {時間|じかん}を{節約|せつやく}する: save time
- {水道代|すいどうだい}を{節約|せつやく}する: save on water bills
- エネルギーを{節約|せつやく}する: conserve energy
- {節約|せつやく}{生活|せいかつ}: frugal lifestyle
- {節約|せつやく}{術|じゅつ}: money-saving tips

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {倹約|けんやく}する: to be thrifty — emphasizes a lifestyle of careful, habitual frugality, while {節約|せつやく} focuses more on specific acts of saving
- {貯金|ちょきん}する: to save money — refers to putting money aside in savings, rather than reducing spending
- {浪費|ろうひ}する: to waste — the opposite of {節約|せつやく}, meaning to spend resources carelessly
